name: hivepantry
description: HivePantry is a log of calories and macronutrients for AI agents. A Cloudflare Worker serves MCP and REST. D1 keeps the log.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply hivepantry-db --local --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Your admin password. Use a minimum of 16 characters. You sign in to /console with it. You make agent tokens there. Keep it in a safe location.

PANTRY_TZ.description: Your IANA time zone, for example America/New_York. Days and daily totals use this time zone. If you are not sure, keep UTC.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Optional. This enables Google sign-in through Cloudflare Access. Keep it empty now. To set it after the deploy, refer to docs/deploy.md.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Optional. This enables Google sign-in through Cloudflare Access. Keep it empty now. To set it after the deploy, refer to docs/deploy.md.
